issue: H1/Orion baseline features were built excluding only their own recipient study; they could incorporate held-CD4 response-bank rows. Direct source-only decoder fitting therefore did not establish complete CD4 study exclusion.
discovered_by: Implementation dependency review before count generation, not performance-based tuning
repair: V58 will exclude CD4 as well as the recipient source study from every calibration baseline and verify invariance when held-study response rows are poisoned. Frozen PIE controls, gene axes and three-head outputs are reused unchanged.
